decision: Accept an optional terminal period for every unquoted inserted paragraph or comment action text
scope: Only newly inserted paragraphs and comment action posts; preserve all other characters, styles, targets, positions, statuses and post counts. Replacement strings remain exact.
period_style: An optional paragraph period must have the same style as the preceding text
analysis_role: Post-hoc human-adjudicated sensitivity; preserve frozen primary grades and raw traces
review_limit: This intent rule does not constitute a complete blinded trace audit
